# ResumeAudioBus <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Audio](BlitzBasic-Audio)

</div>


```blitzbasic
ResumeAudioBus:Void bus:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bus` | In | Int32 | required | A bus from [CreateAudioBus](CreateAudioBus), or `0` for the master bus. Anything else is a runtime error. |

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Plays the channels of a bus that [PauseAudioBus](PauseAudioBus) paused on. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

## Differences

* A channel that [PauseChannel](PauseChannel) paused on its own stays paused, and so does a channel on a bus that feeds a paused bus.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
ResumeAudioBus world
```
